intake.matter_summary: Buyer under a signed earnest-money contract for a 320-acre Texas rangeland tract (Edwards County) for a combined solar array and cattle operation. Title work surfaced a questionable access easement, a severed mineral estate held by a third party, and a seller demand to reserve a surface easement around an existing water well. Firm to advise and renegotiate the deed and access terms toward a closeable deal.
intake.referral_source: referred by the buyer's real-estate agent

conflicts_check.notes: No current or former firm client appears among the seller, the adjacent landowner, the mineral owner, the title company, or opposing counsel. No conflict identified.

time_entries.narrative: Initial client intake interview; assess purchase, intended solar and cattle use, and preliminary title concerns.
Open matter file; review executed Farm and Ranch earnest-money contract; calendar feasibility and closing deadlines.
Review Lone Mesa title commitment; issue-spot access easement, mineral reservation, and pipeline exceptions.
Analyze Deloria survey; compare recorded easement to surveyed road; locate well within the western flat.
Client counseling call regarding the three title problems and preliminary options.
Draft strategic settlement-and-negotiation plan outline; build research plan for access cures.
Draft and send letter to seller's counsel Faircloth on access, minerals, and the requested well reservation.
Strategy session; sequence access, mineral, and well cures and identify the party controlling each.
Prepare full SSNP; separate client interests from stated positions; assess alternatives to agreement.
Client counseling on acquiring an easement from Sandoval versus seeking a price reduction.
Draft proposed corrective access-easement terms and cost-allocation options.
Negotiation call with Faircloth on deed form, mineral treatment, and the well reservation.
Revise deed and well-reservation term sheet after the negotiation call.
Counsel client on the well-relocation option and revised price allocation.
Draft proposed special warranty deed with mineral exception and a bounded well easement.
Negotiate access easement with Sandoval's counsel; draft grant and road-maintenance covenants.
Client counseling on final well terms and surface-protection strategy.
Prepare surface-protection provisions addressing the severed mineral estate.
Negotiation session with Faircloth toward final deal terms.
Revise closing term sheet; coordinate with Lone Mesa on an access endorsement.
Client counseling on final terms and the remaining decisions before closing.
